whatAYeaDid: Requested that the Mayor call on the Provincial Government to halt reductions to local Public Health Unit, land ambulance, and Dearness Home funding and to restore long-term care funding through the provincial tax base rather than the municipal property tax levy, and received the Ontario Health Coalition delegation.
